metadata.title: Chromatic Spacetime Viscosity (CSV) Framework v2.5: Simulation Modules and Monte Carlo Parameter Recovery Datasets
metadata.description: Comprehensive simulation payloads, strain-gated master dispersion models, BCS Kerr quasinormal mode overtone damping analyses, and 500-trial Monte Carlo parameter recovery datasets for the Chromatic Spacetime Viscosity (CSV) framework v2.5.
